title: astracantha thracica subsp. calabrica
intro: Astracantha thracica subsp. calabrica, commonly known as Italian spiny broom, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family known for its spiny branches and medicinal properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which provide its health benefits. The health benefits of Astracantha thracica subsp. calabrica include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antihistaminic, antiarthritic, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful for treating allergies, joint pain, and wounds.
